title: Community of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone finished their oath, an old yet familiar aura suddenly descended. Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul emerged slowly from the Void, bringing key information that could reverse the entire battle situation. It turned out that the true secret of the Tianji Record was inextricably linked to Cang Yutian's warning on his deathbed.

text.content: Cang Yutian's phantom was like a flickering candle in the wind, finally dissipating completely after uttering that spine-chilling warning. The starlight across the sky returned to silence. Only the torn page of the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand glowed faintly golden, as if responding to something. He lifted his gaze to the silhouettes gradually gathering around him, yet his heart remained unexpectedly tranquil—the stillness before a storm often serves as the most fitting moment for oaths.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was the first to step into this clearing where starlight lingered, her plain white dress rustling in the night wind. Her gaze swept over Chen Ji's slightly pallid face, her brow creasing. Her voice carried an unintentional softness: 'That phantom just now... was it Cang Yutian? The founding ancestor of the Tianqing Sect?' She paused, seemingly processing this shocking revelation. 'What did he say?'

Chen Ji didn't immediately respond. Instead, he slowly tucked the Tianji Record fragment into his sleeve. His gaze passed Su Qingyao and landed on three streaks of light streaking through the distant sky—Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and a shadowy figure he hadn't anticipated. 'He said,' Chen Ji's lips curved meaningfully, 'someone is watching from outside the chess game.'

Han Lie landed with a violent surge of spiritual energy. The Xuanwu Sect's top prodigy remained steeped in killing intent, clearly having fought through ambushers to arrive. He glanced at everyone present, his gaze finally fixing on Chen Ji. His fists crackled as he clenched them: 'Waste, you'd better give me an explanation—why did I encounter Demonic Path assassins on my way here?'

Ye Qing emerged from the shadows in a black纱裙, her charm edged with sharpness. A轻笑 escaped her lips, her brow raised slightly: 'Young Master Han suspects my Holy Sect? You're overestimating yourself.' Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji briefly before withdrawing a time-worn jade pendant from her sleeve. 'Chen Ji, this is what you wanted—your father's keepsake. I found it.'

text.content: As Chen Ji took the jade pendant, his fingertips trembled slightly. The jade was still warm and smooth, the Chen family emblem carved on it remained clear. Yet it carried a presence he'd never sensed before—a wisp of his father's remnant divine consciousness. He drew a deep breath, tucking the pendant into his chest. His voice was calm to the point of coldness: 'My thanks. This kindness, I will remember.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan materialized like a phantom. The Tianqing Sect's elder patriarch emanated an aura as profound as an abyss, his depths impossible to fathom. He surveyed the gathering, his aged gaze finally settling on Chen Ji. A complex, indecipherable light flickered in his ancient eyes: 'The young ones have gathered quite completely. Is there no place for this old man?'

Chen Ji turned, directly meeting Ling Yuan's unfathomable gaze. At this moment, the timidity typical of a废物 disciple vanished entirely from him, replaced by a composure and sharpness forged through trials. He slightly clasped his hands in salute, his manners impeccable yet laced with hidden barbs: 'Senior Ling, you're too kind. Your prestige naturally makes you an honored guest at this gathering. However, I wonder—are you here for the banquet or to make trouble?'

text.content: The air froze instantly. Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, studying the transformed young man before him with an unreadable expression. Han Lie instinctively tightened his fists. Su Qingyao quietly stepped back half a pace, positioning herself to shield Chen Ji. Ye Qing watched the spectacle with keen interest. Yet Chen Ji remained unmoved, as if his provocative words had been mere pleasantries rather than a challenge to a sect master's authority.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter: 'Well said,废物 Chen Ji! In three hundred years of life, this is the first time a junior has questioned me so directly.' He restrained his smile, a flash of sharpness piercing through his clouded eyes. 'But you're right—today, I came for the banquet. Since someone watches from beyond the chess game, let me see what you're truly made of, Chess Player.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's words carried layers of meaning, Han Lie watched with predatory eyes, and Ye Qing's jade pendant still retained warmth. Faced with this intricate situation, Chen Ji needed to make his first move—would he show sincerity through openness, or maintain initiative through strategic retreat?

choices.description: Fully disclose Cang Yutian's warning to everyone, demonstrating sincerity to earn trust
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Han Lie's stances remain unclear; frankness may backfire
choices.process_label: 陈机决定向众人坦诚相告

dialogue.content: Chen Ji surveyed the crowd, his expression grave: 'Since everyone is here, some things can no longer be concealed. Ancestor Cang Yutian said before his death—the Tianji Record's chess game has someone watching us.' He paused. 'This means all of us may merely be pieces in a grander game.'

text.content: As his words fell, everyone's expressions shifted variedly. Su Qingyao's face paled slightly, Han Lie furrowed his brow, Ye Qing looked pensive, yet Ling Yuan's expression remained inscrutable. Chen Ji understood—the true test had only just begun.

choices.description: Only reveal partial information, keeping the biggest secret in one's heart
choices.visible_cost: May Arouse Suspicion Among the Group
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao May Sense Something Amiss

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained expressionless, only saying indifferently: "Cang Yutian Patriarch did leave a message, but heavenly secrets are unfathomable—he only left one warning: the true enemy may never have appeared within our sight." He intentionally spoke vaguely, while secretly observing each person's reaction.

text.content: Su Qingyao acutely caught the reservation in Chen Ji's words. She gave him a deep look but did not expose him publicly. Ling Yuan stroked his beard with a smile, seemingly quite satisfied with this answer. Han Lie snorted coldly, clearly not buying this vague explanation.

choices.description: Proposing everyone fulfill their own duties, replacing empty talk with action

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze sweeping across everyone present: "Empty talk harms a nation, practical action prospers it. Instead of debating who is trustworthy and who is suspicious, let's each showcase our strengths." He paused, "Han Lie, with peerless combat power, can be the vanguard; Ye Qing, proficient in demonic path secret techniques, can be a covert operative; Sect Master Ling, with profound cultivation, can be the rear support."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Han Lie's expression slightly improved, and for once he did not make a sarcastic remark. Ye Qing's mouth curved slightly upward, clearly quite satisfied with this arrangement. Even Ling Yuan nodded slightly, seemingly without objection. For the first time, the group coexisted in such a manner, and the atmosphere quietly underwent a subtle shift.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly stepped forward, her black veil shimmering with an eerie glow under the moonlight. She stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, her voice unusually serious: "Chen Ji, do you know what information is hidden within this Jade Pendant?" She paused, "What your father left before his death was no ordinary memento—it was a crucial clue about the true origin of the Tianji Record."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly—this was the first time he had lost composure before everyone. He unconsciously tightened his grip on the Jade Pendant at his chest, his knuckles turning white from the pressure. Ye Qing's words struck like a heavy hammer, hitting the softest part of his heart—he had been searching for the truth about his father for so long that he almost believed it would forever remain beyond his reach.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao sensed Chen Ji's unusual state and quietly moved half a step closer to him. Her slender fingers gently brushed his hand—a silent gesture of comfort that contained countless unspoken words. Her gaze carried both heartache and determination, as if saying: No matter what happens, I am here.

Han Lie watched this scene, his expression complex and hard to decipher. He thought of his numerous confrontations with Chen Ji—this man he had regarded as worthless had always managed to turn the tide from certain defeat. Now, even the Demonic Path Saintess, Ye Qing, had retrieved a memento for him. He suddenly spoke, his tone carrying an unexpected respect he himself had not noticed: "Chen Ji, our rivalry can be set aside for now. First, tell me about your father's memento—what exactly is written in it?"

text.content: Moonlight fell like water upon this group of people with varied identities but surprisingly aligned purposes. Ling Yuan, Han Lie, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing—among them were former enemies, allies, and some whose stance remained unclear. But at this moment, they all chose to temporarily set aside their prejudices, gathering around Chen Ji and waiting for him to unveil the long-sealed truth.

choice.prompt: The memento conceals crucial clues about the Tianji Record's origin, and everyone awaits his explanation. At this moment, Chen Ji faces a choice: to immediately activate the divine consciousness within the Jade Pendant and take a certain risk, or to wait until after the decisive battle?

choices.description: Activate the Jade Pendant's divine consciousness before everyone, risking backlash to gain their trust
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial information and unite people's hearts
choices.risk_hint: The power sealed within the Jade Pendant is unknown and may become uncontrollable
choices.process_label: 陈机决定激活父亲遗物

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly lifting the Jade Pendant into his palm. He closed his eyes, focused his mind, and guided a thread of spiritual energy into it. In an instant, the Jade Pendant erupted with blinding golden light, and a mighty yet gentle force suddenly burst forth—that was Chen Fu's residual divine consciousness, finally awakening upon sensing the bloodline.

dialogue.content: A translucent figure slowly rose from the Jade Pendant—that was the last trace of spiritual consciousness remaining from Chen Ji's father. Gazing at his son after years apart, the elderly face displayed a complex expression of relief intertwined with guilt: "Ji'er... the Tianji Record did not originate from the mortal realm. It is the vessel through which Heavenly Will descends to the mortal world. Our Chen family... is merely the guardian it has chosen..."

choices.description: Put away the Jade Pendant and decide to examine it after the decisive battle

dialogue.content: Chen Ji put the Jade Pendant back into his arms, his expression calm: "Father's belongings, I will naturally find an opportunity to examine them. But at present, there is something more important." He surveyed everyone, his gaze firm, "Ladies and gentlemen, we gathered here not to reminisce about the past, but to face the coming final decisive battle."

text.content: Ling Yuan stroked his beard and nodded, a trace of appreciation flickering in his eyes. Han Lie appeared somewhat disappointed, yet didn't voice objections. Ye Qing's lips curved with a meaningful smile, seemingly acknowledging Chen Ji's choice. The group began to scrutinize this former废物 disciple more seriously, for the first time perceiving him as a genuine core member.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, his aged voice tinged with profound sentiment: "I have lived for over three hundred years, believing I understood the ways of the world, yet never imagined standing shoulder to shoulder with those from the Demonic Path." He gazed at Ye Qing, his expression complex, "Holy Maiden, do you truly intend to cooperate with this old man and our companions? Are you not fearful of the Holy Sect's retribution afterward?"

Ye Qing sneered, her black veil rustling dramatically in the wind: "Ling Sect Master, you overestimate the Holy Sect's significance." A spark of hatred glimmered in her eyes, "In the Holy Sect's perspective, I'm merely a disposable piece on their chessboard. Since they showed no mercy first, why should I adhere to righteousness?" She turned to Chen Ji, "I chose to cooperate with Chen Ji not for his strength, but because he's the sole individual who truly understood my predicament."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ye Qing, a flicker of emotion crossing his face. This seemingly cold demonic path Holy Maiden bore unimaginable suffering behind her composed exterior. He recollected the moment he revealed the prophecy through the Tianji Record—at that instant, the shock and vulnerability in her eyes made him realize this woman possessed far greater inner strength than her surface suggested.

dialogue.content: Han Lie suddenly knelt on one knee, this top prodigy from Xuanwu Sect actually paying Chen Ji a profound salute. His voice rang out powerful and unwavering: "Chen Ji, in terms of wisdom, I'm inferior to you; in cunning, I'm no match. Yet one thing remains crystal clear to me—though you devise many strategies, you never betray those who place their trust in you. From this day forward, I, Han Lie, shall follow your command!"

text.content: This scene left everyone stunned. Ling Yuan's pupils narrowed, Su Qingyao wore an expression of surprise, while Ye Qing's lips curved slightly. Chen Ji observed the kneeling Han Lie, a whirl of complex emotions surging within. This former rival who once dismissed him as worthless now actually submitted willingly. He suddenly comprehended a profound truth—true strength lies not in making enemies fear, but in earning their genuine respect.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji bent down to raise Han Lie, his voice carrying an unintentional warmth: "Brother Han, there's no need for such formality. Though we harbor past grievances, these pale before overarching principles." Releasing his hand, he turned to face the entire group, "Everyone, though I lack talent, I, Chen Ji, pledge with you all—this battle, we shall not return unless victorious!"

text.content: "Victory or no return!" Han Lie was the first to respond, his voice echoing thunderously. Su Qingyao followed, her eyes glistening with tears yet radiant with a brilliant smile. Ye Qing gave a slight nod, her black veil gently fluttering. Ling Yuan sighed deeply, ultimately nodding in agreement. Beneath the starlight, five figures stood shoulder to shoulder, like an unbreakable fortress. In this moment, the gears of destiny began to turn.

choice.prompt: The oath was made, and everyone stood united in purpose. Yet before the final battle, one crucial matter remained to be decided—who would lead this ultimate confrontation? Chen Ji needed to make a pivotal decision.

choices.description: Recommend Ling Yuan to lead, demonstrating magnanimity to gain greater unity
choices.visible_reward: Resolve Ling Yuan's hostility, form unified strength
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may have ulterior motives, guidance may deviate

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ling Yuan, cupping his hands in salute: "Ling Sect Master, your virtue is esteemed and your cultivation profound. This battle concerns the world's survival, so the younger generation dares to propose—that Ling Sect Master leads the overall command. What do you think?" This statement shocked everyone. Su Qingyao appeared worried, Han Lie furrowed his brow, but Chen Ji's expression remained composed.

text.content: Ling Yuan froze momentarily, a complex light flickering in his aged, turbid eyes. This young man actually dared to hand over leadership to him? Was it genuine trust or a strategic retreat? He fell silent for a long while, ultimately sighing: "Very well. This old man accepts this weighty responsibility and will surely not disappoint everyone's expectations."

choices.description: Self-recommendation for leadership, demonstrating protagonist's sense of responsibility
choices.visible_reward: Firmly grasp the initiative in the battlefield
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Han Lie may not be convinced

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, eyes blazing intensely: "Everyone, this battle originated from the Tianji Record, so naturally I should be the one to conclude it." He surveyed the group, "Though my Combat Power falls short of Brother Han and my cultivation below Sect Master Ling's, I possess the Tianji Record—capable of divining Heavenly Secrets within a three-hour timeframe. This foresight is my greatest advantage."

text.content: Han Lie was the first to nod, his eyes filled with conviction. Ye Qing let out a soft laugh, indicating his agreement. Even Ling Yuan stroked his beard in silence, as if having no objection to this arrangement. Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji's upright back, and a surge of pride welled up in her heart—this was the Chen Ji she knew, appearing ordinary on the surface, yet truly unfathomable.

choices.description: Propose establishing a Decision Committee to jointly discuss major matters
choices.visible_reward: Prevent One Person's Arbitrary Decisions, Let Everyone Display Their Strengths
choices.risk_hint: May Result in Discussion Without Resolution

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then slowly said: "I have a proposal—we shall establish a Decision Committee for this battle, composed of five members: Sect Master Ling, Brother Han, Ye Qing, Junior Sister Su, and myself. Major matters will be decided by vote, one person, one vote." He smiled faintly, "This way we can pool our wisdom while checking each other. What does everyone think?"

text.content: Everyone looked at each other, then nodded one after another. This plan took into account the interests of all parties, avoiding dictatorship while also preventing endless discussion without resolution. Ling Yuan stroked his beard and exclaimed in admiration: "A brilliant scheme of pooling wisdom and mutual checks. Chen Ji, this breadth of vision and wisdom, this old man cannot compare."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly stepped forward, her slender fingers gently grasping Chen Ji's hand. Her gesture was bold yet natural, as if declaring something to everyone. Her gaze at Chen Ji was filled with tenderness and determination: "Chen Ji, whatever you decide, I will support you." Her voice was soft, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, "This time, I won't let you bear the burden alone anymore."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at this woman who had once been cold as frost, now willingly setting aside all her pride for him. His heartstrings were gently plucked, and a warm current surged in his chest. He didn't speak, only turning his hand to grip hers tightly. At this moment, no thousands of words were needed—the hearts had already connected.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing watched this scene, a meaningful smile curving at the corner of her mouth. She didn't disturb them with words, only quietly gazing at the dawning light on the horizon. After a moment, she softly said: "Everyone, dawn is approaching. No matter what awaits us ahead, at least at this moment, we are no longer alone."

text.content: The first rays of morning light pierced through the clouds, falling upon these figures standing shoulder to shoulder. Chen Ji took a deep breath, feeling the warmth emanating from the Jade Pendant in his embrace, as well as the warmth of Su Qingyao's palm beside him. He knew that from this moment on, he was no longer a chess player facing fate alone—they were a true community of shared destiny.

However, just as everyone was immersed in the joy of unity, the Void suddenly rippled with an eerie disturbance. An ancient yet familiar aura slowly emerged from the Void—that was Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul—he should have been sleeping on the first page of the Tianji Record, yet he abruptly appeared before everyone. His arrival was too诡异, as if he had long foreseen this moment.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice was ancient and hoarse, yet carried an heart-stopping urgency: "Chen Ji, I have sensed your oath. But there is something you must know—" his fragmented soul trembled slightly, "Cang Yutian's words before his death about 'someone watching outside the chess game' were not empty threats. That existence, I have been tracking it for three hundred years... it is the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—that ultimate existence he had thought would only be faced in Volume Eight—was actually watching him from the very beginning? His meticulous planning, his every calculated step—were they merely a laughable joke before that invisible eye? He unconsciously tightened his grip on Su Qingyao's hand, and an unprecedented chill surged through his heart.
